title: Boss: the payments poison loop
summary: Classify failures from real log lines, route retries through TTL tiers by reading x-death, and plan a safe DLQ drain.

steps.title: INC-6120: payments-consumer pinned at 100 % CPU
body: > Since 09:58 one message is redelivered thousands of times a minute and 41,000 payments are stuck behind it.
> The consumer requeues on **every** exception. A tax-service blip at 09:40 also left transient failures
> mixed in. The parking lot already holds 312 messages from last week that nobody looked at.
10:02:11.004 WRN payments-consumer MessageId=pay-381 System.Text.Json.JsonException: 'x' is an invalid start of a value.
10:02:11.210 WRN payments-consumer MessageId=pay-377 System.TimeoutException: tax-svc did not answer in 2000 ms
1. Classify each failure from its log line as transient or permanent.
2. Route every failure: permanent to the parking lot; transient to the next TTL tier
(`payments.retry.10s`, `payments.retry.1m`, `payments.retry.10m`) based on the `x-death` history, and to
the parking lot when the tiers are used up.
3. Produce a drain plan for the parking lot: redrive what the fixes cover, in batches, and list what stays.

steps.title: Classify from the log line
prompt: Write `string Classify(string logLine)` returning `"transient"`, `"permanent"` or `"unknown"`.
Find the **first** word in the line that ends in `Exception` (a run of letters, digits and dots, such as
`System.Text.Json.JsonException`), and use its simple name (after the last `.`):
- permanent: `JsonException`, `FormatException`, `ValidationException`, `NullReferenceException`;
- transient: `TimeoutException`, `TaskCanceledException`, `HttpRequestException`, `SocketException`;
- `SqlException`: transient if the line contains `1205` (deadlock victim), otherwise permanent;
- anything else, or no exception in the line: `"unknown"`.
hints: Take the part after the last `.` and switch on it.
template: {{CODE}}
Dojo.Eq("JSON is permanent", "permanent", Classify("10:02:11.004 WRN payments-consumer MessageId=pay-381 System.Text.Json.JsonException: 'x' is an invalid start of a value."));
Dojo.Eq("a timeout is transient", "transient", Classify("10:02:11.210 WRN payments-consumer MessageId=pay-377 System.TimeoutException: tax-svc did not answer in 2000 ms"));
Dojo.Eq("deadlock victim is transient", "transient", Classify("ERR Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlException (0x80131904): Transaction (Process ID 61) was deadlocked ... Error Number:1205"));
Dojo.Eq("other SQL errors are permanent", "permanent", Classify("ERR Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlException (0x80131904): Invalid column name 'Amount'. Error Number:207"));
Dojo.Eq("an unknown exception", "unknown", Classify("ERR MessageId=pay-9 Acme.Payments.LedgerLockedException: busy"));
Dojo.Eq("no exception at all", "unknown", Classify("INF MessageId=pay-1 processed in 41 ms"));
Dojo.Eq("the first exception wins", "transient", Classify("WRN System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException: 503 ---> System.Text.Json.JsonException"));
Dojo.Eq("a bug is permanent until a deploy", "permanent", Classify("ERR System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set at PaymentMapper.Map"));

steps.title: Route through the TTL tiers
prompt: Write `string Route(IDictionary<string, object?>? headers, string kind, string[] tiers, string parkingLot)`
returning the queue to send the failed message to:
- `kind == "permanent"` → `parkingLot`;
- otherwise (`"transient"` or `"unknown"`): `retries` = the **sum** of the `count` values of the `x-death`
entries with `reason == "expired"` whose `queue` is one of `tiers`. If `retries < tiers.Length` return
`tiers[retries]`, else `parkingLot`.
As before, `queue` and `reason` may be `byte[]` (UTF-8) or `string`, `count` is a `long`, and headers or
`x-death` may be missing.
```text
no x-death                                → payments.retry.10s
x-death: [payments.retry.10s expired ×1]  → payments.retry.1m
x-death: [10s ×1, 1m ×1, 10m ×1]          → payments.parking-lot
starter: string Route(IDictionary<string, object?>? headers, string kind, string[] tiers, string parkingLot)
solution: string Route(IDictionary<string, object?>? headers, string kind, string[] tiers, string parkingLot)
if (headers is not null && headers.TryGetValue("x-death", out var raw) && raw is IEnumerable<object> deaths)
if (item is not IDictionary<string, object?> d) continue;
if (Text(d, "reason") == "expired" && queue is not null && tiers.Contains(queue)
&& d.TryGetValue("count", out var c) && c is long n)
static string? Text(IDictionary<string, object?> d, string key) =>
d.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v switch { byte[] b => Encoding.UTF8.GetString(b), string s => s, _ => null } : null;
hints: Reuse the `Text` helper from the x-death fix: `byte[]` or `string`, anything else is null.
Sum the counts of matching entries into a `long retries`, then index `tiers[retries]` if it is in range.
template: {{CODE}}
byte[] DojoBytes(string s) => Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s);
Dictionary<string, object?> DojoDeath(string queue, string reason, long count) =>
new() { ["queue"] = DojoBytes(queue), ["reason"] = DojoBytes(reason), ["count"] = count };
var dojoTiers = new[] { "payments.retry.10s", "payments.retry.1m", "payments.retry.10m" };
const string DojoPark = "payments.parking-lot";
Dojo.Eq("first failure goes to the first tier", "payments.retry.10s", Route(null, "transient", dojoTiers, DojoPark));
Dojo.Eq("permanent is parked at once", DojoPark, Route(null, "permanent", dojoTiers, DojoPark));
var dojoOne = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["x-death"] = new List<object?> { DojoDeath("payments.retry.10s", "expired", 1), DojoDeath("payments", "rejected", 1) } };
Dojo.Eq("after one retry: the next tier", "payments.retry.1m", Route(dojoOne, "transient", dojoTiers, DojoPark));

var dojoAll = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["x-death"] = new List<object?> { DojoDeath("payments.retry.10m", "expired", 1), DojoDeath("payments.retry.1m", "expired", 1), DojoDeath("payments.retry.10s", "expired", 1), DojoDeath("payments", "rejected", 3) } };
Dojo.Eq("tiers used up: parking lot", DojoPark, Route(dojoAll, "transient", dojoTiers, DojoPark));

Dojo.Eq("unknown errors are retried like transient ones", "payments.retry.10m", Route(new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["x-death"] = new List<object?> { DojoDeath("payments.retry.10s", "expired", 2) } }, "unknown", dojoTiers, DojoPark));
var dojoText = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["x-death"] = new List<object?> { new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["queue"] = "payments.retry.10s", ["reason"] = "expired", ["count"] = 1L } } };
Dojo.Eq("string header values", "payments.retry.1m", Route(dojoText, "transient", dojoTiers, DojoPark));
var dojoOther = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["x-death"] = new List<object?> { DojoDeath("refunds.retry.10s", "expired", 5) } };
Dojo.Eq("other queues' history is ignored", "payments.retry.10s", Route(dojoOther, "transient", dojoTiers, DojoPark));

steps.title: Plan the parking-lot drain
prompt: Write `List<string> DrainPlan(List<(string Id, string Exception)> parked, ISet<string> fixedExceptions, int batchSize)`:
- the messages whose `Exception` is in `fixedExceptions` are redriven, in parking-lot order, in batches of
`batchSize`: one line per batch, `"batch {n}: {ids}"` with the ids joined by `", "` (`n` from 1);
- then one line for what stays: `"keep: {id} ({exception}), ..."` in parking-lot order, or `"keep: none"`.
```text
DrainPlan([pay-1 Json, pay-2 Timeout, pay-3 Json, pay-4 Json], {Json}, 2)
→ ["batch 1: pay-1, pay-3", "batch 2: pay-4", "keep: pay-2 (Timeout)"]
starter: List<string> DrainPlan(List<(string Id, string Exception)> parked, ISet<string> fixedExceptions, int batchSize)
solution: List<string> DrainPlan(List<(string Id, string Exception)> parked, ISet<string> fixedExceptions, int batchSize)
hints: Build the batch lines first, then append the single keep line.
template: {{CODE}}
var dojoParked = new List<(string, string)> { ("pay-1", "JsonException"), ("pay-2", "TimeoutException"), ("pay-3", "JsonException"), ("pay-4", "JsonException"), ("pay-5", "LedgerLockedException") };

Dojo.Eq("redrive the JSON fix in batches of 2", new List<string> { "batch 1: pay-1, pay-3", "batch 2: pay-4", "keep: pay-2 (TimeoutException), pay-5 (LedgerLockedException)" }, DrainPlan(dojoParked, new HashSet<string> { "JsonException" }, 2));

Dojo.Eq("two fixes, one big batch", new List<string> { "batch 1: pay-1, pay-2, pay-3, pay-4", "keep: pay-5 (LedgerLockedException)" }, DrainPlan(dojoParked, new HashSet<string> { "JsonException", "TimeoutException" }, 10));

Dojo.Eq("nothing fixed yet", new List<string> { "keep: pay-1 (JsonException), pay-2 (TimeoutException), pay-3 (JsonException), pay-4 (JsonException), pay-5 (LedgerLockedException)" }, DrainPlan(dojoParked, new HashSet<string>(), 3));
Dojo.Eq("an empty parking lot", new List<string> { "keep: none" }, DrainPlan(new List<(string, string)>(), new HashSet<string> { "JsonException" }, 3));
